# Outreach Recruitment

> Malta's leading recruitment agency connecting EU candidates with jobs in Malta and across Europe.

Outreach Recruitment is a Malta-based recruitment agency that connects employers with qualified EU candidates across various sectors. We provide end-to-end recruitment support including candidate sourcing, CV screening, interview coordination, and visa assistance.

## Job Seekers
- [Current job openings](https://outreachrecruitment.net/jobs): Browse open roles in Malta and apply directly
- [Study in Malta](https://outreachrecruitment.net/study-in-malta): Consultation and university program guidance for international students
- [Blog](https://outreachrecruitment.net/blog): Career advice and Malta job market insights

## Employers
- [Partner with us](https://outreachrecruitment.net/employers): Recruitment and talent sourcing services for employers in Malta
- [Contact us](https://outreachrecruitment.net/contact-us): Get in touch to discuss hiring needs

## Optional
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/outreach-recruitment-agency/): Company updates and job postings
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/outreachrecruit/): Company updates and job postings
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/outreachrecruitment_agency): Company updates and job postings
